reflection.title: Reflection

questions.question: What must individuals do to survive public psychological disintegration at the reveal?

options.label: A
options.text: Double down on Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge until the Flash finishes safely.
options.rationale: Vaping calcifies the pineal; Mind Camp enforces captivity — opposite of survival prep.

options.label: B
options.text: Sever the 3 Strings, detox heavy metals to repair the pineal, and build inner frameworks that can hold Scare Events without psychological collapse.
options.rationale: Survival prep: cut Religion/Finance/Perceived Knowledge, detox pineal with cilantro, chlorella, and zeolite, and brace for 97% NPC evaporation at the collapse sequence.

options.label: C
options.text: Ignore detox and wait for NPCs to explain the sky pixelation in university lectures.
options.rationale: Death-cycle Grey escort is the old trap; liberation path is string severance, detox, and bracing for NPC evaporation.

options.label: D
options.text: Join 33rd Degree ranks to reform the cage from inside while keeping all three strings intact.
options.rationale: All three strings must be severed and pineal detox is specified.

questions.hint: Sever 3 Strings + pineal detox + brace for 97% NPC evaporation.
